title: Modernize macOS development environment
goal: Deliver a reproducible, themed macOS development environment with mise-owned runtimes, managed editors, safer Git worktrees, coherent keybindings, and verified bootstrap documentation.
scope: Consolidate Node, pnpm, Bun, Go, uv, and Python under documented owners
Remove unused direnv and archive or rebuild legacy Python environments safely
Manage Neovim and Zed configuration with Dusk themes
Modernize Git worktree helpers and resolve terminal keybinding collisions
Add a curated Brewfile, bootstrap/check tasks, and complete documentation
nonGoals: Changing OrbStack or adopting Apple container
Deleting unknown user data or publishing changes
constraints: Preserve existing uncommitted README, Zsh, mise, and FSH work
Back up unmanaged editor configuration before Stow adoption
Use reversible migration gates before runtime or environment removal
Keep application runtime databases outside Stow

steps.title: Capture reversible baseline
steps.target: existing working tree and live editor configs
steps.action: Back up protected uncommitted files and live editor configs, then record runtime and repository baseline evidence.
steps.validation: Backups exist outside the repository and checksum comparison succeeds.

steps.title: Configure mise runtimes and tasks
steps.action: Pin supported Node LTS, pnpm, Bun, Go, uv, Python installer, and standard project task helpers.
steps.validation: mise install and fresh-shell origin/version checks pass; task listing is complete.

steps.title: Cut over machine runtime ownership
steps.action: Switch Node, pnpm, Bun, and Go command ownership to mise, preserve project constraints, and remove superseded Homebrew/global installations only after probes pass.
steps.validation: Fresh shell resolves each runtime through mise and representative project metadata remains unchanged.

steps.title: Remove unused direnv
steps.action: Confirm no user project .envrc, remove the shell hook and formula, and validate mise activation.
steps.validation: direnv is absent, no hook is loaded, and Zsh/mise checks pass.

steps.title: Archive legacy Python environments
steps.target: legacy project virtual environments and Python.org 3.13
steps.action: Archive legacy venvs with manifests and checksums; rebuild reproducible environments where requirements exist; retain or remove base interpreters only when references are cleared.
steps.validation: Archive restore test passes, active rebuilt environments import successfully, and no remaining venv references a removed interpreter.

steps.title: Adopt managed Neovim config
steps.action: Preserve the current LazyVim setup, add Dusk themes and consistent Space-leader behavior, and adopt through selective Stow.
steps.validation: Neovim headless startup succeeds and live managed files are repository symlinks.

steps.title: Adopt managed Zed config
steps.action: Preserve durable settings, remove ephemeral state, enable Vim mode, add Dusk themes and consistent Space-leader bindings without touching prompt databases.
steps.validation: JSON-with-comments files parse after normalization; managed files are symlinks and prompt database checksums are unchanged.

steps.title: Modernize Git and resolve keybindings
steps.action: Replace obsolete or unsafe aliases, add safe worktree helpers, set main as default branch, and move the tmux prefix to Ctrl-Space while retaining fzf Ctrl-T and AeroSpace Alt.
steps.validation: Git config parses, temporary worktree lifecycle passes, and isolated tmux configuration reports the expected prefix and bindings.

steps.title: Add curated Brewfile and bootstrap
steps.action: Declare direct dotfile prerequisites and applications while excluding mise-owned runtimes and unsafe cleanup behavior.
steps.validation: brew bundle check passes on the current Mac and bootstrap dry-run/check paths are idempotent.

steps.title: Complete setup documentation
steps.action: Document ownership, setup, tasks, themes, keybindings, worktrees, migration, and rollback; repair malformed duplicate text.
steps.validation: README commands match tracked files and validated behavior.

steps.title: Validate and review integrated result
steps.action: Run focused static, shell, mise, editor, Git, tmux, Stow, and Brewfile checks and obtain independent code review.
steps.validation: All in-scope checks pass and no blocker, critical, or major review findings remain open.

reviewFindings.title: Reviewer requested restoring pyenv initialization
reviewFindings.detail: Resolved as not applicable: pyenv removal was an explicitly authorized, already-completed migration and part of the protected pre-existing Zsh diff; uv now owns Python and existing constrained projects were rebuilt or validated.

reviewFindings.title: TPM skip wording overstated behavior
reviewFindings.detail: README now says INSTALL_TMUX_PLUGINS=0 skips TPM plugin installation; TPM checkout initialization remains part of bootstrap.

reviewFindings.title: Markdown workplan receipts were stale
reviewFindings.detail: Execution receipts and resume point were updated before re-review.

reviewFindings.title: Machine-local Reika wrapper is non-portable
reviewFindings.detail: Resolved by documenting the protected pre-existing wrapper as an intentionally local customization whose target binary is not installed by bootstrap.
